Items eaten:
- Muesli, about 50 g: roughly 190 kcal.
- Yogurt (Farmers Union pot, about 160 g), likely Greek-style and probably poured onto the muesli: roughly 150–200 kcal.
- Peaches in juice, about 100 g: roughly 50 kcal.
- Small spread portion, partially used, about 5 g: roughly 35 kcal. I counted it modestly as part of the total.
- Mug contents (unclear what it held, possibly milk or tea): estimated at about 40 kcal.
- The sugar packet was not used, so it adds nothing.

Totals:
- Energy: 190 + 180 + 50 + 30 + 40 ≈ 490 kcal.
- Mass: 50 + 160 + 100 + 5 ≈ 315 g, rounded up to about 320 g after allowing for some of the mug contents.
